source.headline: China to pump $54bn into state banks and insurers to boost economy

DXY.source: latest available market update; Reuters described the dollar as under pressure on Sep 7

VIX.source: CBOE close via published market data

learning_v2.note: No ACTIONABLE v2 context-aware segment was used to materially change confidence; current China support facts and contemporaneous market context dominate.

predictions.mechanism: A large state capital injection into Chinese banks and insurers supports regional risk sentiment and the China-sensitive Australian equity complex, although high oil and global yields cap the strength of the signal.
predictions.invalidation: Chinese equities reject the stimulus impulse, regional risk sentiment weakens, or rising yields and oil dominate the session.

predictions.mechanism: Chinese financial-system support is mildly positive for broader Asian risk appetite, but the Nikkei is less directly exposed and remains constrained by high global yields, oil and yen-policy risk.
predictions.invalidation: Asian equities reverse lower or yen strength and rate pressure overwhelm the regional risk-on impulse.
